requirement: Three physical nodes each obtain a real typ relay candidate from both public TURN servers, then complete the 100 MiB P2P V2 matrix with SHA-256 equality; HSD leecher must report path=relay.
notes: TOFUTURE 14ba0e60 seed attaches Mac b1b19d49 and HSD f4961153; both leechers complete 100 MiB with matching SHA-256. TURN A 43.142.74.71:3479 and TURN B 134.175.243.146:3479 each produced typ relay for all three machines. Mac's successful path=relay output was overwritten by a stale worker JSON after completion, so the Mac 100 MiB artifact at .matrix/p7-physical/leech-mac-dual/dest/payload.bin was re-hashed and matched. Distribution is per-pair rendezvous, not strict 50/50 L4 balancing; only the TOFUTURE-seed topology was run.
